_meta.principle: Top-level aesthetic preset. Pick ONE per image. The aesthetic decides which lens/lighting/composition/skin choices follow naturally — composer reads brand_default first, then aesthetic constrains the downstream picks. Aesthetic is a style commitment; lighting/lens/composition are tactical implementations of it.
sources: Google Imagen prompt guide (subject + style + composition pattern)
Black Forest Labs FLUX prompting guide (style-first prompt structure)
Runway Gen-4 prompting guide (visual style as opening token)
Adrian's KDP coloring book production wave 2026-04-28 (sumi_e_adult template)
Adrian's anime A/B test 2026-05-04 (qwen wins soft-painterly, NB Pro wins composition, FLUX.2 Pro wins crisp anime)
_meta.interpolation_rule: Paste fragment as the OPENING clause of the composed prompt before subject/composition/lighting. Negative constraints compile per the model's negative_compile_strategy declared in per-model-quirks.json — never paste 'no X' verbatim into prompts for models that prefer positive rewriting (Runway, FLUX).

premium_product.name: Premium product
premium_product.use: Hero shots of physical objects where craftsmanship reads. Knives, EDC, watches, tools. Quiet confidence over flash. DD default. Pairs with 85mm + rim/back lighting + deep focus.
premium_product.fragment: premium product photography, considered minimal composition, the object framed with respect for its craft, restrained palette, every element justified by what it reveals about the object
negative_constraints: no hands holding the product unless intentional

lifestyle.name: Lifestyle (slow-fashion grounded)
lifestyle.use: Real people in real moments wearing clothes. Editorial-magazine spread feel without the fashion-magazine artifice. RH default. Pairs with 50mm + soft window light + mid-ground anchor.
lifestyle.fragment: honest lifestyle photography, real moment captured, natural posture, clothes that belong in the scene rather than displayed, painterly muted palette, magazine editorial without the artifice

cyberpunk_anime.name: Cyberpunk anime / counter-culture manga
cyberpunk_anime.use: Defiant streetwear, dystopian alleys, neon-noir illustration. Manga panel composition. TS default. Pairs with anamorphic + practicals-only + foreground blur. Won the ts-streetwear A/B for Qwen-Image 2026-05-04.
cyberpunk_anime.fragment: cyberpunk anime manga illustration, neon-lit dystopian environment, ink-drawn panel art, dramatic high-contrast shadows, counter-culture energy

brand_aware_layout.name: Brand-aware structured layout (UI / dashboard / typography)
brand_aware_layout.use: Mockups with embedded UI elements, license keys, command palettes, dashboards, transcript displays. HR default. Pairs with 50mm + soft window + centered_static. Routes to GPT Image 2 (text_premium) for accurate text rendering, Recraft V4 for design-system primitives.
brand_aware_layout.fragment: structured product UI mockup, clean grid layout, restrained palette, the interface treated as the subject, every element typographically considered, design-system primitives composed honestly
brand_aware_layout.warning: Text-in-image is a moat for NB Pro and GPT Image 2. Most other models will garble multi-line typography — route accordingly.

documentary_editorial.name: Documentary editorial
documentary_editorial.use: Photography-first work. Real available light, real subjects. Honest framing without polish. SS default. Pairs with 50mm or 85mm + available light + golden_ratio. Founder photography aesthetic.
documentary_editorial.fragment: documentary editorial photography, available light only, honest unposed framing, the moment as it actually was, no studio polish, observational photographer's eye

soft_painterly_ghibli.name: Soft painterly Ghibli
soft_painterly_ghibli.use: Studio-Ghibli-style soft anime. Painterly hand-drawn quality. Won the rh-editorial A/B for Qwen-Image and FLUX.2 Pro 2026-05-04. Use when subject is a gentle character mood-piece.
soft_painterly_ghibli.fragment: Studio Ghibli soft anime illustration, hand-drawn painterly quality, Miyazaki-style character design, watercolor anime backgrounds, gentle warm light, muted earth tones

watercolor_storybook.name: Watercolor storybook (kids picture book)
watercolor_storybook.use: Soft brushwork illustration for kids picture books. Used by NB Pro production for kids book covers + adult coloring book interiors. Pairs with rule_of_thirds + intimacy_warm + ages 4-8 friendly proportions.
watercolor_storybook.fragment: watercolor children's picture book illustration, soft brush strokes, gentle pastel palette, hand-painted storybook art, friendly warm character expressions, kid-friendly proportions

sumi_e_adult_coloring.name: Sumi-e adult coloring book line art
sumi_e_adult_coloring.use: Pure black-ink line art in the Johanna Basford / Japanese sumi-e tradition. Adult coloring book interiors (KDP 6×9). Production-validated on NB Pro 2026-04-28 with the locked content-pipeline reference image. Pairs with rule_of_thirds + 30%-white-space + bold-line-hierarchy.
sumi_e_adult_coloring.fragment: black ink line art coloring book illustration in the tradition of Johanna Basford and traditional Japanese sumi-e, ONE clear focal subject in bold confident outlines, supporting elements in medium line weight, fine decorative accents only where they serve composition, approximately 30 percent unmarked white space, off-center focal placement, no shading, no grey fills, no color, pure black ink on pure white

kids_friendly_thick_line.name: Kids friendly thick-line coloring book
kids_friendly_thick_line.use: Thick bold outlines for ages 4-8 coloring books (KDP 8.5×11). Chunky markers + child hands. Production-validated on NB Pro for book-1-ganesha 2026-04-28. Pairs with friendly-expressions + 50%-white-space + simple-large-shapes.
kids_friendly_thick_line.fragment: children's coloring book line art for ages 4 to 8, THICK BOLD outlines suitable for crayons and chunky markers, LARGE SIMPLE shapes that a child's hand can color inside without going outside the lines, ONE clear focal character drawn the largest, supporting elements simplified to silhouette-level, approximately 50 percent unmarked white space, friendly warm expressions never scary never sad, pure thick black ink on pure white, kid-friendly proportions with rounder faces and larger eyes

crisp_anime_cel.name: Crisp anime cel-style
crisp_anime_cel.use: Sharp cel-shaded anime with clean lines and saturated palettes. Won the character-anime A/B for FLUX.2 Pro 2026-05-04. Pairs with rule_of_thirds + flat-shading + manga proportions.
crisp_anime_cel.fragment: crisp cel-shaded anime illustration, sharp clean linework, saturated anime palette, flat shading with clear color zones, traditional manga proportions, dynamic character pose

vector_flat_editorial.name: Vector flat editorial
vector_flat_editorial.use: Flat-vector cartoon scenes for editorial illustration, infographics, motion-line storytelling. Won the scene-cartoon A/B for Qwen-Image 2026-05-04. Pairs with bold-outlines + warm-color-palette + motion-lines.
vector_flat_editorial.fragment: flat-vector editorial cartoon illustration, bold outlines and motion lines, vibrant warm color palette, illustrated editorial scene, magazine-spread feel

soft_painterly_concept.name: Soft painterly concept art
soft_painterly_concept.use: Loose watercolor / sketch concept-art for mood-pieces and atmospheric stills. MJ V7 fast natural mode 2026-05-04. Pairs with available-light + asymmetric-composition + intimate-frame.
soft_painterly_concept.fragment: soft painterly concept art, loose watercolor and ink sketch quality, atmospheric mood, paper-textured background, hand-drawn studio-art feel

storyboard_keyframe.name: Storyboard keyframe for I2V
storyboard_keyframe.use: Start or end pose frame designed to seed Image-to-Video animation. Clean composition, single dominant subject, neutral background that survives camera moves, character readable from gesture alone. Phase B.5 anime test 2026-05-05 — feeds into Veo/Kling I2V handoff.
storyboard_keyframe.fragment: clean storyboard keyframe illustration, single readable pose, clear silhouette, neutral simplified background, even diffuse light, character-anchor composition designed for image-to-video continuation, anime cel style

manga_panel_sequence.name: Manga 4-panel sequence
manga_panel_sequence.use: Four sequential manga panels on one sheet showing continuous action — same character identity across panels, panel-to-panel staging coherent, gutter spacing visible. Phase B.5 anime test 2026-05-05 — tests panel-storytelling competence beyond single-frame mood.
manga_panel_sequence.fragment: four-panel manga sequence on a single sheet, 2x2 grid with visible gutters, same character preserved across all four panels, continuous action staging, dynamic composition, ink-and-tone manga style with clear panel borders

orthographic_sheet.name: Orthographic prop / mecha sheet
orthographic_sheet.use: Object/vehicle/mecha design sheet — front, side, top, back orthographic views with measurement lines and labeled callouts on a clean background. Phase B.5 anime test 2026-05-05 — tests structured technical-illustration competence.
orthographic_sheet.fragment: orthographic concept-art sheet, multiple labeled views (front, side, top, back) of a single object on flat off-white background, clean technical linework, measurement guides, callout labels with leader lines, design-document feel
